title: Two-variable finite truncation induction for internal Hom
statement: Let k be a field, X a finite-type k-scheme, ell a natural number, and Λ an ell-adic finiteness coefficient as in [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Assume ringChar(k) ≠ ell. Assume RHom(F[0],G[0]) is bounded constructible for every pair of constructible Λ_X-modules F,G. Then the bounded constructible object property [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] is closed under the native derived internal Hom [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. The conclusion is the existing IsMonoidalClosed structure; both finite truncation inductions are performed explicitly.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3) and Remark 6.8.15; finite truncation devissage in each variable of native derived internal Hom. Degree-zero constructible internal-Hom finiteness is assumed in this conditional lemma.

proof.text: Put R=Λ_X, C=Mod_R(Sh(X_proet,Ab)), D=D(C), and P=boundedConstructible R. The spectrum of a field is Noetherian (its only prime is zero and the field is a Noetherian ring); finite type over this base makes X Noetherian by lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian. By lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-scheme-closed-subsets-minimal every nonempty family of closed subsets of the underlying space of X has a minimal member, so that space is Noetherian. Thus lem-sfb-dc-ell-adic-triangulated applies to the given finiteness coefficient and makes P triangulated. The isomorphism invariance clause of lem-sfb-dc-module-devissage makes P isomorphism closed. No separatedness or positive-characteristic assumption is needed here.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3), finite cohomological truncation devissage; Remark 6.8.15

proof.text: Verify the ambient hypotheses before applying native exactness. By sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor, Ab with its tensor product over Z, unit Z and Hom groups is a Grothendieck abelian category with a closed symmetric monoidal structure (additive in each variable, since each tensor functor is a left adjoint), and the small pro-etale site of X is essentially small relative to the size of these Hom groups. Hence lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed applies to that site with coefficients Ab: abelian sheaves carry the additive closed symmetric tensor and are Grothendieck abelian. The free-abelian flat-cover theorem and the sheaf flat-resolution theorem give functorial flat resolutions of these sheaves. Applying the module-object Grothendieck and flat-resolution theorems to their commutative ring object R makes C Grothendieck abelian with functorial flat resolutions. The relative module tensor is symmetric and closed by def-sfb-modobj-internal-hom; it is additive since its defining coequalizer of additive tensor functors is additive. These are precisely the hypotheses on C in the native contravariant exactness theorem.

source.place: Ambient module-object setup for the internal-Hom preservation assertion; generic categorical prerequisites

proof.text: For any K in D choose a K-flat homotopy representative S with Q_h(S) isomorphic to K, using lem-sfb-kflat-derivability. Its hypotheses hold by step 2: Grothendieck exact colimits exist, and closedness makes tensor preserve colimits. The K-flat tensor-left theorem gives coherent integer-shift comparisons and triangulatedness for Q_h(S) tensor-derived -. Transport these along Q_h(S)≅K to obtain the same for T_K=K tensor-derived -. This is the fixed native tensor: sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom defines it by this K-flat construction, so there is no comparison with a different derived tensor model.

source.place: Native K-flat tensor in the internal-Hom assertion; source library Monoidal/Shift.lean, tensor-left shift and triangulated structure

proof.text: Let H_K=RHom(K,-). The defining native adjunction T_K ⊣ H_K is supplied by sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom. Apply clause (iii) of lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-shift-compatibility-unique to the coherent shift structure of T_K from step 3: it supplies a coherent shift structure on H_K with both unit and counit shift-compatible. All hypotheses of lem-sf-triangulated-right-adjoint now hold, so H_K preserves distinguished triangles. In particular this argument proves covariant exactness for the actual right adjoint used in the item, without identifying it with ringed-site sheaf Hom.

source.place: Tag 0A8D, lemma-adjoint-is-exact; coherent mate version supplied by the cited Mathlib leaf

proof.text: Fix K in D and define Q_K(L):=P(RHom(K,L)). Since H_K is triangulated, and P is triangulated and isomorphism closed by step 1, Q_K has these same closure properties: it holds at zero, shift comparisons carry its values to shifts of values of P, and the image of a distinguished triangle is distinguished, so closure under two known vertices gives the third. A functor carries an isomorphism to an isomorphism, which gives isomorphism closure. The module devissage lemma therefore reduces Q_K(L) for bounded constructible L to Q_K(G[0]) for all constructible G.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3), finite cohomological truncation devissage; Remark 6.8.15

proof.text: Spell out this first finite induction. For cohomology supported in [a,b], use the triangle τ≤b−1 L → L → H^b(L)[−b] → (τ≤b−1 L)[1]. The empty interval is zero. For a single nonzero degree the complex is isomorphic to H^a(L)[−a], so the required assertion follows from the degree-zero obligation Q_K(H^a(L)[0]) and shift closure. In the induction step the lower truncation has support [a,b−1] and the same constructible lower cohomology; its assertion follows by induction, and the shifted top cohomology satisfies Q_K by that obligation. Applying H_K to the triangle and using P on its two outer vertices proves the middle vertex. This is exactly the finite induction furnished by lem-sfb-dc-module-devissage. It leaves, for each constructible G, the obligation P(RHom(K,G[0])).

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3), finite cohomological truncation devissage; Remark 6.8.15

proof.text: Fix such a G and put V=G[0]. Apply lem-weil-native-internal-hom-contravariant-exact to C from step 2 and W=V. It equips F_V=RHom(-,V):D^op → D with coherent opposite shifts and a triangulated structure. Thus Q^G(K):=P(F_V(op K)) is an isomorphism-closed triangulated property on D. Indeed op(K[m])=(op K)[−m], so F_V(op(K[m]))≅F_V(op K)[−m]. A distinguished triangle A→B→C→A[1] becomes the reversed distinguished triangle op C→op B→op A→(op C)[1]; applying F_V and the closure of P proves the required two-out-of-three property for Q^G. Zero and isomorphisms are handled as in step 5.

source.place: Tag 08JC, lemma-RHom-triangulated; cited native exactness theorem supplies the coherent opposite shifts

proof.text: Apply lem-sfb-dc-module-devissage to Q^G. Its degree-zero condition is Q^G(F[0])=P(RHom(F[0],G[0])), exactly the hypothesis of the item for every constructible F. Explicitly, induct on the finite cohomology interval of K: the empty interval gives zero, a singleton gives a shift of its constructible homology, and the triangle τ≤b−1 K→K→H^b(K)[−b] gives, after contravariant Hom into V, a distinguished triangle with first two terms RHom(H^b(K)[−b],V) and RHom(K,V), and third term RHom(τ≤b−1 K,V). The first term is RHom(H^b(K)[0],V)[b], covered by the hypothesis and shift closure; the third is covered by induction. Closure of P proves the middle. Consequently every bounded constructible K satisfies Q^G, for every constructible G. This discharges all obligations of the first induction and yields P(RHom(K,L)) whenever P(K) and P(L).

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3), finite cohomological truncation devissage; Remark 6.8.15

proof.text: The native internal Hom is the ihom of the fixed closed monoidal structure by sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom. Therefore the result of step 8 is exactly the field prop_ihom(K,L): P(K) → P(L) → P(ihom(K,L)) of ObjectProperty.IsMonoidalClosed. Supplying this field proves the stated structure, with no monoidal-unit or tensor-closure assertion required.

source.place: Conclusion: native internal-Hom preservation, expressed by IsMonoidalClosed.prop_ihom

from.place: The assertion that native derived internal Hom of two bounded constructible complexes is bounded constructible: two finite truncation reductions to the constructible degree-zero case.

lean.statement:
theorem boundedConstructible_hom_closure
    {ℓ : ℕ} [IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    (hsingle : ∀ (F G : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)),
      IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) F →
      IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) G →
      boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
        (((derivedHom Λ X.left).obj
          (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G))) :
    (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)).IsMonoidalClosed
